summary: Tested expanded /api/events (national Leaan aggregator + Modi'in municipal + curated). 18/18 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend Events tab validated: source banner reads 'Live events from Modi'in Municipality, Leaan (national) + curated picks'; 314 upcoming events near Tel Aviv (all sources), family_only toggle reduces to 118 and toggle label updates; event cards render Hebrew text with dir=auto, 304 Tickets buttons and 18 Calendar buttons (Modi'in only). City search (Haifa) + Events tab refreshed events list. Regression: /places/search returns google_enabled=true with live Google Places results near Tel Aviv (121 activities).

minor.issue: FIXED during this run: municipal (Modi'in) events were emitted for any user within trigger_radius_km(35) of Modi'in but never filtered against the caller's radius_km, so a search with radius_km=3 near Tel Aviv still returned Modi'in events ~29km away. Added distance check that skips municipal events beyond radius_km (server.py /api/events).

action_items: None blocking. Consider adding an ages badge / kid-friendly indicator on Leaan cards (national aggregator returns ages=[] so most non-kids-section events lose age info).
critical_code_review_comments: events_source.fetch_leaan(): if the leaan HTML no longer contains __NEXT_DATA__ (site refactor), `m.group(1)` will raise AttributeError inside the try, currently caught -- fine, but consider explicit `if not m` check for clearer logging.
server.py /api/events previously did not filter municipal events by user radius_km; fixed. Consider also filtering curated EVENTS by trigger only when needed to avoid always injecting national picks.
test_sababakids_api.py test_root previously asserted google_enabled is False; updated to True to match GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY being set in this environment.
@app.on_event('shutdown') still deprecated - migrate to lifespan (carried over from iteration 1).
seed_data_creation: None - uses live leaan.co.il + modiin.muni.il data with 30-min in-process cache.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Events endpoint now merges 3 streams (municipal Modi'in, national Leaan aggregator via __NEXT_DATA__, curated) and correctly honours user radius_km. GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is live in this env so /api/ returns google_enabled=true and /places/search returns real Google Places results. Data is largely Hebrew by design.
